notes: Paper (Jaeckel & Spannowsky 2015, arXiv:1509.00476) derives NEW exclusion limits on ALP-photon (g_agamma) and ALP-hypercharge (g_aBB) couplings by recasting LEP-I Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma branching ratio data, filling the MeV-10 GeV gap. Despite the 'DarkPhoton' hint, this is clearly an axion-like-particle two-photon coupling paper (y-axis of Fig. 4 is Log10 g_agamma [GeV^-1]). No numerical table is provided; the limit exists only as shaded regions in Fig. 4, so data_points are approximate values read from the figure description (limits at the few x 10^-4 GeV^-1 level over ~MeV to m_Z, weakening at low mass due to ALP decay length and at m_a near m_Z). Paper also contains FCC-ee and LHC 13 TeV/100 fb^-1 projections, but the primary result is the measured LEP recast limit. Confidence level not explicitly stated in paper. No DM density assumption (collider bound). The g_aBB hypercharge limit (Fig. 4a) is a separate stronger bound not encoded here since the enum targets the photon coupling. | selector: text (sole candidate)
